title: CatalogEntry
description:
Frontmatter of a catalog entry. The body carries the human description.

A catalog entry describes a source; it does not itself verify anything. A claim may only be tagged `[verified]` once the source content is committed, not merely once the source is registered here.

content_committed.description: Whether the source content itself has been committed to this repository, as opposed to the source merely being registered.

feeds.description: Corpus classes this source can supply values for.
